names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Isidor din Chios».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ισίδωρος που μαρτύρησε στη Χίο», with the rank word and the place of martyrdom left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 14 May, „Свети мученик Исидор.“ — Свети left off, which is not a rank, and мученик left off, which is the `martyr` this folder already carries in `types`. The heading gives no epithet, no island and no year: Chios, Decius, the army, the ox sinews, the tongue, the dumb commander, Ammonius and the 251 are all in the body. **The form folds with `isidore-of-rostov`, and the fold is made by this one day**: the Prologue's third entry for the same 14 May is the fool for Christ of Rostov, whose heading strips to the same bare Исидор. Recorded as deliberate in the run's findings.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1118, «Исидор Хиосский, мч.», with the rank word left off; that page lists «День памяти: 14 мая» and no other day. The day's own line gives the bare name and no epithet — «Мч. Исидора (251).» — because the calendar keeps a second Isidore on the same day and distinguishes them in the name links. `fk.mjs` on «Исидор Хиосский» returned NONE before the write.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 мая ст. ст. — «Мч. Исидора (251).»

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the other three churches, the same year, 251, and the same man: the soldier of Chios whose tongue was cut out and who went on praising Christ. The day line gives him no epithet at all and the name page, 1118, heads him «Исидор Хиосский, мч.» The calendar keeps **two** Isidores on this day and its own service line says so — «14 мая: Мученика Исидора Хиосского. Блаженного Исидора Ростовского.» — and the two sets of hymns on the page are headed apart, «мученика Исидора» and «блаженного Исидора, Христа ради юродивого»; **the two under the martyr's heading are copied here and the five under the fool's onto that folder.** The troparion is the common of a martyr with his name set into it, which BRIEF.md §4 takes as his. `dates` were not touched: the folder already carries 251 off the Ohrid Prologue and the Russian day line gives the same year. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Isidor din Chios»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ισίδωρος που μαρτύρησε στη Χίο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on, and its synaxarion verse agrees: «Ἐν δ' Ἰσίδωρον ἄορ δεκάτῃ τάμεν ἠδὲ τετάρτῃ». It is plainly the same man, the sailor of the imperial fleet beheaded on Chios under Decius. **He is not the day's other Isidore**: saint.gr keeps on this same 14 May an Isidore of Rostov, a fool for Christ dead in 1474, who is a new folder in batch `el-05-14`. **The Greek adds his birthplace**, Alexandria, and the names the corpus may not hold: the centurion Julius who denounced him and the admiral Noumerios who condemned him. **It adds the whole of the scene with his father**, who came to Chios to argue him out of the faith, cursed him and urged Noumerios to kill him quickly — «παραδώσει εἰς θάνατον πατὴρ τέκνον», the page quotes from Matthew 10. **Myrope is linked**: the Christian woman who took his body out of the ravine by night and then gave herself up so that the guards should not be executed for it, and whom the page sends to 2 Δεκεμβρίου, has a folder. **No year is printed**, only Decius's reign, so no `dates` object is added. **Two apolytikia stand on the page and only one is taken**: the first, Ἦχος δ’ «Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε», is the common of a martyr and is left; the Έτερον, Ἦχος δ’ Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, names him — «παμμάκαρ Ἰσίδωρε» — and is copied. Neither is a mis-hang. The page adds that his skull and the greater part of his relics are in the chapel of his name in the Roman Catholic cathedral of Saint Mark at Venice, with portions at the Metropolis of Chios and at Philotheou on the Holy Mountain.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 27.05.2026 (14. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Исидор.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Greek keeps him on, so nothing moved. **A FIRST DATE FOR A FOLDER THAT HELD NONE**: „где му глава би одсечена 251. године“ → `death` 251, where this folder had no `dates` object at all. It sits inside the reign the entry names — „У време царовања Декијева“ — and the reign was given no bounds and nothing was built on it. **New here, and almost the whole of the account**: that he was taken **by force into the army** from the island of Chios, which is the `soldier` this folder already carries read from the other side; that from childhood he held the faith of Christ and passed his life in fasting, prayer and good works; **his answer to the commander** — that though you kill my body you have no power over my soul, that he has the true and living God Jesus Christ who lives in him now and will be with him after his death, that he is in Him and will remain in Him and will not cease to confess His holy name while the breath is in his body; that he was beaten **with ox sinews** and then **had his tongue cut out, and yet without a tongue spoke by the Spirit of God and went on confessing the name of Christ**; **that the commander was then struck dumb by the punishment of God**, and gave the sign for the beheading without being able to speak it; and that Isidore rejoiced at the sentence and went out praising God to the place of execution. **AMMONIUS IS NAMED AND TAKES NO ROW, ON THE COORDINATOR'S THIRD RULING.** „Његов друг Амоније погребе тело његово, но зато и сам пострада и прими венац мученички.“ — his comrade Ammonius buried his body, and suffered for it himself and received the martyr's crown. **That is a martyrdom narrated, which is the test that earned `laodicius-the-jailer` a row on the Julian 13 May the day before — but Laodicius had a folder and Ammonius has none.** The corpus's two Ammonii were read and he is neither: `ammonius-10-january` is a venerable ascetic, a companion of Anthony the Great, and `ammonius-of-pentapolis` a martyr of Libya in 304 with three named companions. **No folder anywhere, so the row has nothing to attach to and a new folder would be the extension inventing a saint.** He is named in the life, unlinked, with no `related` row — and **this folder's existing life already names him that way**, from doxologia or saint.gr, so nothing about him changed. **`myrope` was already a `related` row** and nothing was added; she is not in this entry at all. `types` untouched: Свети is no rank and мученик is the `martyr` the folder carries. **No `locations`**: Chios is named and this folder has never claimed a point. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Isidor, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nesctricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru.; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Isidor din Hios», Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyr Isidore, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength, he cast down the tyrants and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At his prayers, O Christ our God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς στρατευθεὶς τῷ Βασιλεῖ τῶν αἰώνων, τῶν ἐπιγείων τὴν στρατείαν ἀπώσω, καὶ εὐθαρςῶς ἐκήρυξας Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν· ὅθεν τὸν ἀγῶνά σου, τὸν καλὸν ἐκτελέσας, Μάρτυς θεοδόξαστος, τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἐδείχθης· ὃν ἐκδυσώπει σώζεσθαι ἡμᾶς, τοὺς σὲ τιμῶντας, παμμάκαρ Ἰσίδωρε.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of Άγιος Ισίδωρος που μαρτύρησε στη Χίο

english.text: Enrolled as a soldier of the King of the ages, you thrust away the soldiering of earthly things and preached Christ our God with a good courage; and so, having finished your good contest, you were shown to be a martyr of the Saviour glorified by God. Entreat him that we who honour you may be saved, all-blessed Isidore.

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Исидор/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имеяй бо крепость Твою/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Того молитвами/ спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 мая ст. ст. — «Тропарь мученика Исидора»; it is the common of a martyr with his name set into it

english.text: Thy martyr Isidore, O Lord, in his suffering received an incorruptible crown from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength he cast down his persecutors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Управитель превеликий вселенней ты явился еси, святе,/ твоими к Богу молитвами,/ темже воспеваем тя днесь,/ мучениче Богомудре,/ Исидоре преславне.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 мая ст. ст. — «Кондак мученика Исидора»

english.text: A very great governor of the whole world hast thou been shown to be, O holy one, by thy prayers to God; and so we sing of thee today, O God-wise martyr, most glorious Isidore.

death.note: The first date this folder has carried. The Ohrid Prologue, for the Julian 14 May: „изађе на губилиште, где му глава би одсечена 251. године.“ saint.gr's line for 14 Μαΐου, which this folder was read from, gave no year. The entry also sets the whole account „У време царовања Декијева“, in the reign of Decius, and gives that reign no bounds, so nothing was built on it; the 251 is the only number on the page. No birth is printed.
